proposals.before: 《Zizhi Tongjian》: In the eighth month Chen Hui’s army reached Xiangzhou; Li Hong fought in reverse and was greatly defeated; Wang Qiu died.
proposals.after: 《Zizhi Tongjian》: In the eighth month Chen Hui’s army reached Xiangzhou; Li Hong gave battle and was greatly defeated; Wang Qiu died.
proposals.reason: 逆戰 means to meet the enemy in battle / fight back, not 'fought in reverse'.

proposals.before: On xinhai Chief Minister Han Jian was relieved to Grand Preceptor; Left Vice Director and Co-Grand Councilor Yang She was relieved to his original post; Zhao Guangfeng, grand master of splendid happiness, was made vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor; Du Xiao, drafting academician, vice minister of works, and edict drafter, was made vice director of the Revenue Ministry and grand councilor.
proposals.after: On xinhai Chief Minister Han Jian was relieved to Grand Guardian; Left Vice Director and Co-Grand Councilor Yang She was relieved to his original post; Zhao Guangfeng, Minister of Ceremonies, was made vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor; Du Xiao, drafting academician, vice minister of works, and edict drafter, was made vice director of the Revenue Ministry and grand councilor.
proposals.reason: 太保 is Grand Guardian not Grand Preceptor; 太常卿 is Minister of Ceremonies, not 'grand master of splendid happiness'.

proposals.before: On xinhai Han Jian stepped down as chief minister to Grand Preceptor; Yang She, left vice director and co-grand councilor, returned to his former post; Zhao Guangfeng became vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor; Du Xiao, drafting Hanlin academician and vice minister of works, became vice director of the Revenue Ministry and grand councilor.
proposals.after: On xinhai Han Jian stepped down as chief minister to Grand Guardian; Yang She, left vice director and co-grand councilor, returned to his former post; Zhao Guangfeng, Minister of Ceremonies, became vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor; Du Xiao, drafting Hanlin academician and vice minister of works, became vice director of the Revenue Ministry and grand councilor.
proposals.reason: 太保 should be Grand Guardian; prior office 太常卿 omitted/misrendered in the appointment of Zhao Guangfeng.

proposals.before: On jihai Luo Zhouhan became vice military governor of Tianxiong and ran the prefecture at Prince of Ye Shao Wei’s plea of illness.
proposals.after: On jihai Luo Zhouhan became vice military governor of Tianxiong and ran the prefecture at Shao Wei, Prince of Ye’s plea of illness.
proposals.reason: 鄴王紹威 is Shao Wei, Prince of Ye—not the fused 'Prince of Ye Shao Wei'.

proposals.before: On jihai Luo Zhouhan was made vice military governor of Tianxiong and administered the prefecture, at Prince of Ye Shao Wei’s request due to illness.
proposals.after: On jihai Luo Zhouhan was made vice military governor of Tianxiong and administered the prefecture, at Shao Wei, Prince of Ye’s request due to illness.
proposals.reason: Same fused name error: 紹威 is the personal name; 鄴王 is the title.

proposals.after: On wuwu at Civilization Hall the investiture of Grand Tutor Zhang Zongshi and Grand Guardian Han Jian was completed.

proposals.after: On wuwu the Emperor presided at Civilization Hall where Grand Tutor Zhang Zongshi and Grand Guardian Han Jian completed receiving investiture seals.
proposals.reason: 太保 is Grand Guardian, not Grand Preceptor.

proposals.before: Wang Rensi, detention commissioner, was posthumously made grand master of splendid happiness; Shi Zhao, former Tong escort guard, right vice director; Wang Yanhong, Gao Hanchun, Qiu Fengyan, and Qiu Qiong, escort guards, ministers of justice; Wang Jun, censor-in-chief.
proposals.after: Wang Rensi, detention commissioner, was posthumously made Minister of Works; Shi Zhao, former Tong escort guard, right vice director; Wang Yanhong, Gao Hanquan, Qiu Fengyan, and Qiu Qiong, escort guards, ministers of justice; Wang Jun, censor-in-chief.
proposals.reason: 司空 is Minister of Works, not 'grand master of splendid happiness'; 高漢詮 is Hanquan not Hanchun.

proposals.before: Posthumous honors were granted to detention commissioner Wang Rensi as grand master of splendid happiness, former Tong Prefecture escort guard Shi Zhao as right vice director, escort guards Wang Yanhong, Gao Hanchun, Qiu Fengyan, and Qiu Qiong each as minister of justice, and Wang Jun as censor-in-chief of the Bureau of Censors.
proposals.after: Posthumous honors were granted to detention commissioner Wang Rensi as Minister of Works, former Tong Prefecture escort guard Shi Zhao as right vice director, escort guards Wang Yanhong, Gao Hanquan, Qiu Fengyan, and Qiu Qiong each as minister of justice, and Wang Jun as censor-in-chief of the Bureau of Censors.
proposals.reason: 司空 mistranslated; 詮 should be quan in Gao Hanquan.

decisions.reason: Focus unit 李洪逆戰，大敗 uses 逆戰 for meeting the enemy in battle; "fought in reverse" is a false literalization. "Gave battle" matches the Chinese and the surrounding Tongjian note.
Focus unit 罷守太保 and 太常卿趙光逢: 太保 is Grand Guardian (not Grand Preceptor/太師), and 太常卿 is Minister of Ceremonies, not "grand master of splendid happiness" (光祿大夫). The proposed titles are accurate.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 罷守太保……太常卿趙光逢

decisions.reason: Same focus unit: idiomatic wrongly had Grand Preceptor for 太保 and dropped Zhao Guangfeng’s prior office 太常卿. Grand Guardian and Minister of Ceremonies restore the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 罷守太保……太常卿趙光逢為中書侍郎、平章事

decisions.reason: Focus unit 從鄴王紹威病請也 names title 鄴王 then personal name 紹威. Reordering to "Shao Wei, Prince of Ye" correctly separates title from name; the fused "Prince of Ye Shao Wei" is misleading.
Same focus unit 鄴王紹威: literal likewise fused title and name. "Shao Wei, Prince of Ye" matches the Chinese order of title then given name.
Focus unit 冊太傅張宗奭太保韓建 pairs 太傅 (Grand Tutor) with 太保 (Grand Guardian). Grand Preceptor would be 太師; the proposed Grand Guardian is correct.
Same focus unit 太保韓建; literal Grand Preceptor mistranslates 太保. Grand Guardian is the standard Three Dukes rendering.
Focus unit 贈……王仁嗣司空……高漢詮: 司空 is Minister of Works, not "grand master of splendid happiness"; 詮 is quan, so Gao Hanquan not Hanchun. Both proposed fixes match the Chinese.
Same focus unit: literal repeats the 司空 and 高漢詮 errors. Minister of Works and Gao Hanquan are the correct readings.
Focus unit 詔贈尚書令 names the head of the Department of State Affairs. Minister of Works would be 司空; Director of the Department of State Affairs correctly renders 尚書令.
Same focus unit 尚書令; literal Minister of Works confuses it with 司空. The proposed Director of the Department of State Affairs matches the office title.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0008 shows English Gao Hanchun came only from misreading 詮 in the bad translation; the name claim must use Gao Hanquan while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
